dedupe_keys.name: real world provision of ancillary services by pv energy communities in distribution networks

description: The source documents actual decentralised Q(V), Q(P) and P(f) ancillary-service controls at five PV plants in a Greek 20 kV energy community. The field programme evaluates voltage control and communication disruptions. This application is distinct from the Python controller implementation and the deposited figure datasets, which are linked separately. Source regulatory statements are historical study context and not independently checked current requirements. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Real World Provision of Ancillary Services by PV Energy Communities in Distribution Networks
notes: Native publication date is not a verified observation interval. Project membership alone does not establish resource inclusion. Listed unverified routes timed out in zero-body landing checks; exact native metadata was retrieved successfully. Underlying files remain unchecked.
